front: Name the four components of a time series.
back: Trend (long-run level), seasonality (fixed period), cycle (no fixed length), noise (random rest).
A season has a fixed, known period (7 days, 12 months). A cycle rises and falls with no fixed length.
Additive: y = trend + season + noise (constant swings). Multiplicative: y = trend × season × noise (swings grow with level).

front: How do you turn a multiplicative series into an additive one?
back: Take the logarithm, because log(a × b) = log(a) + log(b).

front: What is the period of monthly data with a yearly season?
back: 12. For daily data with a weekly season it is 7. For hourly data with a daily season it is 24.

front: How do you estimate a linear trend?
back: Least squares: choose the line y = a + b·t with the smallest sum of squared gaps. np.polyfit(t, y, 1).
